description: a 4 × 4 plate 1 thick with a ring torus on its top, major radius 1 and minor 0.5 about (2, 2, 1.3), written by Open CASCADE with every closed edge split in two (ShapeUpgrade_ShapeDivideClosedEdges): the outer circle where the torus leaves the top, radius 1.4, is two half circles between the top and the torus (ADR-0041). One half of it filleted at r 0.1: a plane against a torus coaxial with it, concave, the chain runs on through both vertices and closes as a whole ring, two half tori of minor radius 0.1. Open CASCADE builds the ring as one face

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE builds the blend of the ring (a plane's circle against a torus) as one face spanning a whole turn, V/E/F/L 14/21/10/11, where Arris builds one face per arc and a junction arc and two vertices at each vertex of the split, 16/24/11/12 (ADR-0041); the part and the blend are the same solid, the measures and probes agree with the oracle's
analytic.step_differs: Open CASCADE's own STEP of the result carries its 14/21/10/11 where Arris's carries its 16/24/11/12, one whole-turn blend face against two halves (counts_differ)
